title: DAY 21/90
APTITUDE
scenes.sub: General Aptitude is 15 marks. Let's claim them
scenes.voice: Day twenty one of the GATE M. E. ninety days challenge, eighty seven days left! Today we switch to aptitude, fifteen marks every engineer should collect.

scenes.title: Today's Topic
scenes.voice: Today's subject is General Aptitude. Our topic: Quantitative Aptitude, part one. Fast arithmetic that saves you minutes in the exam.

scenes.title: Cover Today
scenes.voice: Cover percentages, ratio and proportion, averages, profit and loss, time, speed and distance, and time and work.

scenes.title: Quick Tip
scenes.voice: Quick tip. Two successive changes of a and b percent give a net change of a plus b plus a b over one hundred. Up twenty, down twenty? Minus four percent.

scenes.title: Today's Plan
scenes.voice: Start with the free practice PDF on Telegram. Tonight's test runs seven to nine P. M. Use the Telegram link, or simply visit our website, on mobile or laptop.

scenes.title: Day 20 Toppers
scenes.voice: Day twenty toppers! Kunal and Sweta Rani Sahoo both scored a perfect thirty out of thirty, ranks one and two. Atharva Vyas takes rank three with eighteen. Superb work!
